name: base-local
note: Step C-.40 (ADR-D01.40/.41) on the base puzzle (600-cell-Full, Jumble off), with no D02 state, on the build's own session fixture. Local is never empty: on the opening state it draws cell 0's turning region beside Global, as the second pane of composite frames, and its readout says that this is the default. Clicks in Global ask the host for a pick: a hit re-frames Local on the selected sticker's cell (ADR-D01.41) and a miss returns it to cell 0. Since B17 the host picks on the base puzzle too: the corner click, first, lands on a sticker of the base view, and the last click, at the opening's centre (no sticker there on the opening state), clears the selection. A twist (J) and an undo keep both views on one revision. The drags then show the linked rotation as two-views does: a drag in Local and one in Global each turn both views; unlinked, each turns only its own view; linking again returns Local to the shared rotation.
